premises.text: Natural disasters and war zones create a significant need for rapid rebuilding of homes.
premises.evidence_span: There are 400 yearly recorded natural disasters in the world and at least 10 war zones as we speak. This means that every time such disaster strikes, it takes significant resources to rebuild.

premises.text: Traditional construction methods are expensive, time-consuming, and labor-intensive.
premises.evidence_span: It takes a minimum of three months for single-story houses to be built. It's expensive, it's time-consuming, it's labor-intensive, and it's a safety risk.

premises.text: 3D concrete printing can significantly reduce construction time and costs.
premises.evidence_span: Building is a 3D concrete printer designed to build single-story houses in just one week, reducing the total construction time up to 75%.

premises.text: The cable-driven robot design allows for accurate and flexible construction.
premises.evidence_span: we designed and assembled a cable-driven robot, including an automated pulley system. This design can give accurate results, can be easily installed and dismantled on the work site.

premises.text: The concrete mixture developed is stronger and sets faster than traditional mixes.
premises.evidence_span: this mix is two times stronger than the traditional mixes, has 20 times faster setting time, is highly flowable, so it can pass easily through the printer.

premises.text: The global market for real estate and 3D printing in construction is substantial and growing.
premises.evidence_span: The global market share of real estate is currently estimated around 217 trillion dollars, with the Middle East region, the fastest growing construction area in the world.

premises.text: Building can offer custom designs at a faster rate than traditional methods.
premises.evidence_span: Some custom designs of the printer that we have right now, we can build outdoor benches, animal shelters, roadblocks, security cabins, and other designs.

value.text: Families can receive homes quickly and safely after disasters.
value.evidence_span: Building is changing the way houses are built, and giving families homes where natural disasters and wars destroy whole cities.

notes: Competitor details and demo specifics are excluded as they do not constitute premises.
